import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem cumulative_overlap_connected_union {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {A : ℕ → Set X}
  (hA : ∀ n, IsConnected (A n))
  (hCum : ∀ n, (⋃ k ≤ n, A k) ∩ A (n + 1) ≠ ∅) :
  IsConnected (⋃ n, A n) := by
  classical
  let B : ℕ → Set X := fun n => ⋃ k ≤ n, A k
  
  have hStep : ∀ n, B (n + 1) = B n ∪ A (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    ext x
    simp only [B, mem_iUnion, mem_setOf_eq, mem_union]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, hk, hx⟩
      by_cases hkn : k ≤ n
      · exact Or.inl ⟨k, hkn, hx⟩
      · have hkeq : k = n + 1 := by omega
        exact Or.inr (hkeq ▸ hx)
    · rintro (⟨k, hk, hx⟩ | hx)
      · exact ⟨k, Nat.le_trans hk (Nat.le_succ n), hx⟩
      · exact ⟨n + 1, le_rfl, hx⟩
  
  have hB : ∀ n, IsConnected (B n) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        simpa [B] using hA 0
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [hStep n]
        apply IsConnected.union
        · exact (Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty).2 (hCum n)
        · exact ih
        · exact hA (n + 1)
  
  have hChain : ∀ n, (B n ∩ B (n + 1)).Nonempty := by
    intro n
    rw [hStep n]
    rcases (Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty).2 (hCum n) with ⟨x, hxB, hxA⟩
    exact ⟨x, hxB, Or.inr hxA⟩
  
  have hAll : IsConnected (⋃ n, B n) :=
    IsConnected.iUnion_of_chain hB (by
      intro n
      simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hChain n)
  
  have hEq : (⋃ n, B n) = ⋃ n, A n := by
    ext x
    simp only [B, mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, k, hk, hx⟩
      exact ⟨k, hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨k, hx⟩
      exact ⟨k, k, le_rfl, hx⟩
  
  rw [hEq] at hAll
  exact hAll
